notes.title: Game Update 20th of February
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

After gathering information and logs from you we have now released a patch to address the level and item reset issue. We hope that this will now be stable for all players and you will no longer experience any issues with it. 

Here are the patch notes from today:

*Removed all steam cloud saving functionality
*Added full local saving functionality to the game
* We fixed the achievement 'Bloodbath' to trigger correctly once 25 players were harvested. 

You can discuss the patch in this Thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/322920/discussions/3/133257636770883959/

Thank you all very much for your patience and help! 

Cheers,

Stefan

notes.title: Game Update January 10th 2017
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

A short while ago we mentioned that we were working on performance improvements for theHunter: Primal. Today I am happy to announce that we have released a patch that is going to permanently solve some of the issues players were reporting, such as disappearing inventory items and connection problems.

Here are the changes introduced in the patch:

- Implementation of local save with Steam cloud integration and removal of the server side saves.
- Save game data will be downloaded when the game is launched, meaning players will not lose equipment and/or items anymore.
- Offline support has been added to the game - an online connection will no longer be required to play theHunter: Primal, however, Steam will still need to be running in the background. 
- The previous weight restriction has been removed from the inventory capacity.

If you should experience any issues when starting up the game the first time after the changes, please restart Steam as well as Primal and after that you should be able to play normally again. The same applies to spawning with an empty inventory. 

EDIT: We have released a 2nd patch. You can find the patch notes in this Steam announcement: http://steamcommunity.com/games/322920/announcements/detail/248095310212678462

Cheers,

Stefan

notes.title: Post-release heads-up
notes.notes:
Ahoy Primal pioneers and survivors!
 
After the full release yesterday we’ve received a lot of feedback and questions, mostly related to the future of the game, so we thought we should give you a small heads-up on what the future holds for theHunter: Primal.
 
We plan to continue maintaining the game and keep updating it with fixes and tweaks post release. Right now we’re working on Quetzalcoatlus-related bugs and tweaks, they will be included into the next patch.
 
We are satisfied with how the Early Access phase went, with comminuty's help we managed to develop and implement everything we planned and promised when we set off on this journey three and a half months ago - two new dinosaur species, PVP and team support, player XP, in-game currency and store, localization in 13 languages, two new weapons and lots of tweaks and fixes.
 
We’d like to thank you for staying beyond awesome during the Early Access phase. It’s been quite a roller coaster ride and we are eternally grateful to have you, our passionate and engaged community, by our side, reporting bugs, making suggestions, translating, sharing feedback and simply playing and enjoying the game. It wouldn’t have been the same without you.
 
Happy hunting!

Discussion

notes.title: Game Update 2015022303

Live Patch 2015022303

Features
 Players now earn XP when harvesting dinosaurs, XP is based on damage share, dino score and a survival bonus. The survival bonus goes up with with each harvest and is reset on death. Player’s increase in level based on XP amount earned, the player level is not reset when dying.
 Players now earn EG Tokens when harvesting dinosaurs, token amount is based on damage share and dino score. Tokens are not lost when dying.
 An in-game shop has been added where players can use earned EG tokens to buy equipment between lives. The type of equipment available for purchase is tied to player’s level. Note that you still get a free bow, 10 arrows and a map fragment when spawning so unless you want two of these you don’t need to buy one every time you die.

Important note on the server state of XP and Tokens: The system has been running on the live server for a couple of weeks for testing reasons, however with faulty settings. We reset the system last friday in preperation for the release once the correct values where in place but when you first run the game it may show a faulty amount of tokens and XP that reflects things earned before the reset. If this happens, restart the game to get the correct values.

We’ve also made some additional changes behind the scenes to get more control over the random distribution of items which we will use to make further tweaks to the looting experience throughout the week. These tweaks will be made server side without having to patch the client.
* The T-rex and Utahraptors now have a 90 degree turning animation when being aggressive. This should increase their lethality in situations where they have to rotate before attacking.


Bug fixes
* Fix for a common crash when using items
* Fix for a startup crash when the game tried to access the map
* Utahraptor group communication sounds are synced to all players. (so all players hear their sounds)

notes.title: Game Update 2015011402
notes.notes:
Features

 Improved server list
 Item stacking and splitting (in equipment slots). We will improve this further but the current implementation should solve the problem where you had to mess with the inventory in the middle of combat. Stack by drag and dropping on top of equiped items and split by holding Shift while drag and dropping. 
 New item - Merc Binoculars can now be found at some of the ruin sites 
 Dinos now avoid larger dinos when not attacking or searching for players


Changes

 Consumable item inventory capacity cost is now tied to use count. This means that, for instance, a stack of 5 arrows now take up half the space in the inventory compared to a stack of 10. In most cases this means that your current inventory now has more space as most stacks got lighter but there may be some cases where players may get inventories that exceed 100%. It’s nothing to worry about as you will still be able to use the inventory as normal with the exception that no additional items can be added until you have dropped enough of them to get below 100%.
 A little faster loading times


Bug fixes

 Fixed crash that could occur when triceratops got killed in water
 Fixed a crash that could occur when players joined a game directly when it showed up on the server list
 Fix for random crash when a player joined a multiplayer game
 Fix for a random crash
 Minor terrain fixes
 Fix for leaderboard not showing
 Fix for map not being saved correctly between sessions
 Fix for dinos not always rotating correctly towards the player
